note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; participants, parties, the holder and who receives the signal in each scenario are as supplied. A pending turn only means waiting; no preset shows a winner, outcome, required order, time per turn or consequence. Coordinator decision (standing stress rule, 2026-09-26): the long-labels-stress texts are capped for this contrast as a quality choice (strictly longer than baseline, counts equal) — measurements in that preset's description.
